spans.s: See under नि-पा below.
1. नि-˚प m. a water-jar, Nauclea Cadamba, L.
2. नि-˚प mfn. protecting (cf. आके-न्˚), RV.
नि-˚प m. a lord, chief, L.

etym.s: fr. नि + अप्; cf. द्वीप and Pāṇ. vi, 3, 97, Sch.

spans.s: situated low, deep, Kāṭh.
the foot of a mountain, Mahīdh.
Nauclea Cadamba (n. its fruit and flower, Megh.)
Ixora Bandhucca or a species of Aśoka, L.
N. of a son of Kṛtin and father of Ugrāyudha, BhP.
pl. of a regal family descended from Nīpa (son of Pāra), MBh.; Hariv. &c.
N. of a river, VP.
the second rib, VS.
recitation, study, Pāṇ. iii, 3, 64, Kāś.
= -पठ, Pāṇ. iii, 3, 64.
See नि-पठ above.
नि-प˚ठन n. (L.) id.
नि-प˚ठिति f. (Pat. on Pāṇ. vii, 2, 9) id.
नि-प˚ठितिन् mfn. g. इष्टादि.
नि-˚पतन n. falling down, falling, descending, MBh.; Hariv.
(गर्भिण्यागर्भस्य) the lying-in of a pregnant woman, VarBṛS. li, 35
flying, MBh.
नि-˚पातन mfn. (fr. Caus.) throwing down, killing, destroying, knocking out (an eye), MBh.
नि-˚पातन n. causing to descend or fall, throwing down, letting drop or sink, Mn.; Yājñ.; R. (cf. दण्ड-न्˚)
putting on, applying (as a knife), touching with (comp.), Suśr.
overthrowing, destroying, killing, Mn.; MBh.
(in gram.) accidental mention or use of a word, putting down as an irregularity
an irregular form or exception, Prāt.; Pāṇ., Sch.; Vop.
= नि-पतन, falling down (of a fire-brand), Yājñ. i, 145
alighting (said of a bird), Pañc. ii, 57.
नि-˚पतित mfn. flown or fallen down, descended (नभो-न्˚, from heaven), fallen upon or into (loc.), MBh.; Kāv. &c.
decayed, sunk, withered, Dhūrtas.
नि-˚पातित mfn. made to fall or descend on (loc.)
overthrown, beaten down, destroyed, killed, MBh. &c.
(in gram.) irregular, exceptional.
नि-˚पत्य ind. having fallen down &c., MBh.
नि-˚पत्या f. any slippery ground
a field of battle, L.
नि-˚पात्य ind. throwing down, overthrowing, destroying, killing, MBh.; BhP.
नि-˚पात्य mfn. to be cast down or overthrown
(in gram.) to be put down or mentioned as an irregularity.
नि-˚पत्य—रोहिणी f. (prob.) falling and ascending g. मयूर-व्यंसकादि.
नि-˚पात m. falling down, descending, alighting (lit. and fig.), falling from (abl.) into or upon (comp.), rushing upon, attacking (comp.), Mn.; MBh. &c.
decay, destruction, ruin, death, ib.
(from the Caus.) casting, hurling, discharging, Kum. iii, 15
accidental occurrence or mention, Nir.; ĀśvŚr.
(in gram.) irregular form, irregularity, exception (cf. पर-, पूर्व-)
a particle (all adverbs including conjunctions and interjections), Nir.; Prāt.; Pāṇ. i, 4, 56
See under नि-पत्.
नि-˚पात—त्व n. the state of being a particle, MW.
नि-˚पात—प्रतीकार m. the repelling of assaults, ib.
नि-˚पा˚ताव्ययोपसर्ग m. pl. N. of wk.
नि-˚पातक ifc. = पातक, a bad deed, a sin, MBh. v, 4053.
नि-˚पातनीय mfn. to be caused to fall
नि-˚पातनीय m. (with दण्ड m. ‘punishment must be inflicted’), Sāh.
नि-˚पातिन् mfn. falling or flying down, MBh.
falling or alighting on (comp. Ragh. ix, 40; उपरि, Vikr. v, 15)
striking down, destroying, MBh.; Ragh.
नि-˚पात्यमान mfn. being thrown down, being precipitated into (loc.), Prab. vi, 6/7.

नि-√ पद् Ā. -पद्यते, to lie down, rest, lie down with (acc.), RV.; ŚBr. :
Caus. -पादयति, to throw down, fell, ib.
See नि-√ पॄ.
नि-˚परण n. the putting down or offering (of rice &c. to deceased relatives), Nir.; ĀśvŚr., Sch.
(as softly or silently as) the falling of leaves, ŚBr.
1. नि-˚पान n. (or ˚नक, W.) drinking, imbibing, MBh.; BhP.
any place or trough for watering cattle, a well, pool, tank, Mn.; MBh. &c.
a milk-pail, L.
2. नि-˚पान n. place of refuge, Jātakam.
नि-˚पान—कर्तृ m. one who makes a tank, Mn. iv, 211
नि-˚पान—वत् mfn. abounding in pools or tanks, Ragh.
नि-˚पान—सरस् n. a pool or lake for watering cattle, Kād.
नि-˚पीत mfn. drunk in, absorbed, imbibed, drunk up, Kāv.
नि-˚पीत—कुसुम mfn. (a tree) whose blossoms are sucked by (instr.), ŚārṅgP.
नि-˚पीत—तोय mfn. (a river) whose water has been drunk by (instr.), R.
नि-˚पीत—सार mfn. (a lip) whose moisture has been sucked in (that has been kissed), Ṛt.
नि-˚पीति f. drinking, L.
नि-˚पीयमान mfn. being drunk in or imbibed, Kathās.
नि-˚पक mfn. intelligent, wise (cf. Pāli), L.
नि-˚पक m. chief, Divyāv.
, cooking, maturing, ripening, L.
low ground, a valley, RV.
going or about to fall, Hariv.
crushed, destroyed, AV.
नि-˚पीडन n. squeezing, pressing, hurting, giving pain, L.
नि-˚पीडना f. oppression, Sāh.
नि-˚पीडयत् mf(अन्ती)n. pressing, pressing together
(दन्तान्. दन्तैः) gnashing the teeth, Pañc.
नि-˚पीडित mfn. squeezed, pressed, embraced
pained, hurt, Mn.; MBh. &c.
नि-˚पी˚डितालक्तक-वत् ind. like pressed lac, MW.
नि-˚पीड्य ind. having squeezed or pressed or embraced or hurt, MBh.; Kāv. &c.
pressing out, HPariś. (= नि-पीडन).
नि-√ पीय् P. -पी॑यति, to revile, abuse, TBr.
N. of a man, Kṣitīś.
mf(आ)n. (said to be from a √ पुण्), clever, adroit, skilful, sharp, acute, Mn.; MBh.; Suśr.; Kāv. &c.
skilled in, conversant with, capable of (mostly comp. [cf. Pāṇ. ii, 1, 31 and g. शौण्डादि]; but also infin. [Kāv.] loc. [Var.] gen. [Vop. v, 29] or instr. [Pāṇ. ii, 1, 31])
kind or friendly towards (loc. or प्रति, Pāṇ. ii, 3, 43)
delicate, tender, Jātakam.
perfect, complete, absolute (as purity, devotion &c.), Mn.; BhP.
in a clever or delicate manner, MBh.; Kāv.
completely, perfectly, absolutely, exactly, precisely, R. (also निपुण ibc. Pāṇ. vi, 2, 24, and ˚णेन, MBh.; BhP.)
निपुण—तर mfn. more clever or perfect &c.
निपुण—तरम् ind. = next, Pañc.
निपुण—तस् ind. wholly, completely, MBh.
निपुण—ता f. skilfulness, adroitness, carefulness, accuracy, Kāv.; Pañc.
निपुण—दृश् mfn. sharp-sighted, clever, knowing, MW.
or f. N. of an evil demon, Hir.
N. of a waiting-maid, Kālid.
नि-√ पुथ् Caus. -पोथयति, to dash down, Hariv.
the subtle body, VS.; AV. (= सूक्ष्म-देह, Mahīdh.)
strained, filtered, purified, RV.

नि-√ पॄ P. -पृणाति (Pot. -पृणुयात्, Lāṭy.), to put down, pour out, offer (esp. to deceased relatives), AV.; ŚBr. &c.:
Intens. -पोपूर्यते, Pat.
नि-˚पारक mfn. one who puts down &c., Pat.
नि-˚पृत (ĀśvŚr.) and नि-˚पूर्त (Pat.) mfn. put down, poured out, offered.
नि-˚पृत (ĀśvŚr.) and नि-˚पूर्त (Pat.) mfn. put down, poured out, offered.
नि-√ प्रथ् (Caus. aor. -पप्रथन्), to spread or increase, RV. ii, 11, 8.
w.r. for निष्-प्र्˚, Hariv.
नि-प्र-√ हन् P. -हन्ति, to hurt or destroy (with gen.), Pāṇ. ii, 3, 56, Kāś.
Nom. Ā. ˚य॑ते, to keep in one's possession, not to be willing to give up (acc.), AV.
नीप—राज m. or n. the fruit of the Nipa, L.
N. of a descendant of Kaṇva and author of RV. viii, 34.
being low or on the ground, VS.
